newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended slightly firmer on mostly low volume, although traders reported strong demand for the Swiss Federal government's January 2014 bond.
"One client sold it early in the day, but the market saw that it (the 2014) held up at those price levels and then people came in to buy it," said one trader of the 2014 bond.

The 2014 bond yielded roughly 4.15 percent in late trade, with the price quoted late at 100.65/101.15, up roughly half a point from Wednesday's close. The market was closed on Thursday. The 2014 yield contrasted 3.53 pct on the June 2007.
News Swiss April unemployment fell to 5.5 percent from 5.6 percent in March had little impact. Monday market traders said they expected short-term rates to remain steady near-term.
Conf futures CONFc1 up five at 119.95.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 up 14 at 111.55
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 up two at 98.21.
